[1/6] Planning: proper story mechanics (requirement-gated choices, persistent story flags, follow-up transmissions, branch-skipped chapters, ending resolution, 5-act campaign with old-save migration) plus void traversal (deterministic void lanes between black-hole systems, void dive/emerge, tick-driven storms and arrival)

impact_assessment.why: The narrative campaign is a static 3-act linear chain whose choices have no persistent consequences, and the game named VoidFarer has no mechanics for traversing the void between stars despite black-hole systems existing
impact_assessment.benefits: Branching consequences that persist and gate later content, branch-resolvable locked choices with reasons, distinct campaign endings, and a deterministic risk-reward void travel layer with CLI/REST/cockpit parity
impact_assessment.risks: contract: story save schema grows (flags, requirements, endings) and the campaign extends from 3 to 5 acts so the old completed-campaign test contract changes; dependency: none added (stdlib only); concurrency: existing engine lock retained for all new mutations; state: ShipState gains void_traversal with None default and StoryState gains flags/ending_id with empty defaults, both backward compatible via from_dict migration
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first tests for every new behavior, additive serialization defaults for old saves, migration reopens a completed 3-act save into the 5-act campaign deterministically, the changed test contract is recorded in the ADR per PRINCIPLE-014 R2, and all lanes/storms derive from the galaxy seed and engine RNG
